description: This file defines a 'TopNav' UI component using the LightningJS framework. It includes structure for the top navigation bar with a title and a 'New Note' button, styles sourced from a theme, and a method to handle creating a new note via a store. It also references external modules such as 'Blits' for component creation, a theme object for styling, and a store for state management.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with empty title and content and adds it to the store; triggered when the '+ New Note' element receives an 'enter' event.
